summary: The earlier sign-in's leftovers are cleared, and your web session is renewed before it ends.

fixes.title: The earlier sign-in's images are removed
fixes.text: Once the web app uses Microsoft's built-in sign-in, the update removes the earlier sign-in front's images from your registry. The install also removes its old key when the person running it may.

fixes.title: Your web session is renewed in time
fixes.text: The web app renews your sign-in a few minutes before it ends, so you are not asked to sign in again while you work.
